+package auth
+

+	"bytes"

+
+	"github.com/gnolang/gno/tm2/pkg/amino"
+	abci "github.com/gnolang/gno/tm2/pkg/bft/abci/types"
+	bft "github.com/gnolang/gno/tm2/pkg/bft/types"
+	"github.com/gnolang/gno/tm2/pkg/sdk"
+	tu "github.com/gnolang/gno/tm2/pkg/sdk/testutils"
+	"github.com/gnolang/gno/tm2/pkg/std"
+)
+
+func TestInvalidMsg(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	h := NewHandler(AccountKeeper{}, GasPriceKeeper{})
+	res := h.Process(sdk.NewContext(sdk.RunTxModeDeliver, nil, &bft.Header{ChainID: "test-chain"}, nil), tu.NewTestMsg())
+	require.False(t, res.IsOK())
+	require.True(t, strings.Contains(res.Log, "unrecognized auth message type"))
+}
+
+func TestQueryAccount(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	env := setupTestEnv()
+	h := NewHandler(env.acck, env.gk)
+	_, pubkey, addr := tu.KeyTestPubAddr()
+
+	acc := env.acck.NewAccountWithAddress(env.ctx, addr)
+
+	req := abci.RequestQuery{
+		Path: fmt.Sprintf("auth/%s/%s", QueryAccount, addr),
+		Data: []byte{},
+	}
+	res := h.Query(env.ctx, req)
+	require.Nil(t, res.Error)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+
+
+	acc.SetAccountNumber(uint64(1))
+	acc.SetSequence(uint64(20))
+	acc.SetCoins(std.NewCoins(std.NewCoin("foo", 10)))
+	acc.SetPubKey(pubkey)
+	env.acck.SetAccount(env.ctx, acc)
+
+	res = h.Query(env.ctx, req)
+	require.Nil(t, res.Error)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+	bz, err := amino.MarshalJSONIndent(acc, "", "  ")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	require.True(t, bytes.Equal(res.Data, bz))
+}
+
+func TestQueryGasPrice(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	env := setupTestEnv()
+	h := NewHandler(env.acck, env.gk)
+
+	req := abci.RequestQuery{
+		Path: fmt.Sprintf("auth/%s", QueryGasPrice),
+		Data: []byte{},
+	}
+
+	res := h.Query(env.ctx, req)
+	require.Nil(t, res.Error)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+	gp := std.GasPrice{
+		Gas: 100,
+		Price: std.Coin{
+			Denom:  "token",
+			Amount: 10,
+		},
+	}
+	env.gk.SetGasPrice(env.ctx, gp)
+
+	var gp2 std.GasPrice
+	res = h.Query(env.ctx, req)
+	require.Nil(t, res.Error)
+	require.NotNil(t, res)
+	require.NoError(t, amino.UnmarshalJSON(res.Data, &gp2))
+	require.True(t, gp == gp2)
+}
+
+func TestQuerierRouteNotFound(t *testing.T) {
+	t.Parallel()
+
+	env := setupTestEnv()

+
+
+class ConditionProjectionContractTest(TestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def resolve(template, values=None, ignore_errors=False):
+        symbols = IntrinsicsSymbolTable(template=template, logical_id_translator=values or {})
+        return IntrinsicResolver(template=template, symbol_resolver=symbols).resolve_template(
+            ignore_errors=ignore_errors
+        )
+
+    def test_resource_conditions_filter_before_resolving_resource_bodies(self):
+        template = {
+            "Conditions": {
+                "Enabled": {"Fn::Equals": [{"Ref": "Mode"}, "on"]},
+                "Disabled": {"Fn::Not": [{"Condition": "Enabled"}]},
+            },
+            "Resources": {
+                "Included": {
+                    "Type": "Custom::Thing",
+                    "Condition": "Enabled",
+                    "Properties": {"State": "ready"},
+                },
+                "Excluded": {
+                    "Type": "Custom::Thing",
+                    "Condition": "Disabled",
+                    "Properties": {"Unresolvable": {"Fn::Select": [9, ["invalid"]]}},
+                },
+                "Unconditional": {"Type": "Custom::Thing", "Properties": {"State": "always"}},
+            },
+        }
+
+        result = self.resolve(template, {"Mode": "on"})
+
+        self.assertEqual(set(result["Resources"]), {"Included", "Unconditional"})
+
+    def test_included_resources_do_not_retain_condition_metadata(self):
+        template = {
+            "Conditions": {"Enabled": {"Fn::Equals": [1, 1]}},
+            "Resources": {
+                "Included": {
+                    "Type": "Custom::Thing",
+                    "Condition": "Enabled",
+                    "Properties": {"State": "ready"},
+                }
+            },
+        }
+
+        result = self.resolve(template)
+
+        self.assertNotIn("Condition", result["Resources"]["Included"])
+        self.assertEqual(result["Resources"]["Included"]["Properties"], {"State": "ready"})
+
+    def test_output_conditions_filter_before_resolving_output_values(self):
+        template = {
+            "Conditions": {
+                "Enabled": {"Fn::Equals": [1, 1]},

+            },
+            "Outputs": {
+                "IncludedOutput": {"Condition": "Enabled", "Value": "visible"},
+                "ExcludedOutput": {
+                    "Condition": "Disabled",
+                    "Value": {"Fn::Select": [9, ["invalid"]]},
+                },
+            },
+        }
+
+        result = self.resolve(template)
+
+        self.assertEqual(set(result["Outputs"]), {"IncludedOutput"})

+def aware(year, month, day, hour=0, minute=0):
+    value = datetime(year, month, day, hour, minute)

+            name='recipient-service', policy=self.policy, retry=5,
+            escalate_after=10)
+
+    def add_rule(self, position, user=None, calendar=None):
+        return SchedulePolicyRule.objects.create(
+            schedule_policy=self.policy, position=position, user_id=user,
+            schedule=calendar, escalate_after=0)
+
+    def add_event(self, calendar, title, start, end):
+        return Event.objects.create(
+            calendar=calendar, creator=self.alpha, title=title,
+            description='coverage', start=start, end=end)
+
+    def test_rules_and_calendar_names_follow_policy_order(self):
+        instant = aware(2020, 1, 15, 12)

+// +build integration
+
+package integration
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"sync"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/pborman/uuid"
+
+	kapi "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/api"
+	kapierrs "k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/api/errors"
+	"k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/api/meta"
+	"k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/apiserver"
+	"k8s.io/kubernetes/pkg/client/restclient"
+
+	templatesapi "github.com/openshift/origin/pkg/template/api"
+	testutil "github.com/openshift/origin/test/util"
+	testserver "github.com/openshift/origin/test/util/server"
+)
+
+func TestPatchConflicts(t *testing.T) {
+
+	testutil.RequireEtcd(t)
+
+	_, clusterAdminKubeConfig, err := testserver.StartTestMasterAPI()
+
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	clusterAdminClient, err := testutil.GetClusterAdminClient(clusterAdminKubeConfig)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	clusterAdminKubeClient, err := testutil.GetClusterAdminKubeClient(clusterAdminKubeConfig)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected error: %v", err)
+	}
+
+	objName := "myobj"
+	ns := "patch-namespace"
+
+	if _, err := clusterAdminKubeClient.Namespaces().Create(&kapi.Namespace{ObjectMeta: kapi.ObjectMeta{Name: ns}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("Error creating namespace:%v", err)
+	}
+	if _, err := clusterAdminKubeClient.Secrets(ns).Create(&kapi.Secret{ObjectMeta: kapi.ObjectMeta{Name: objName}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("Error creating k8s resource:%v", err)
+	}
+	if _, err := clusterAdminClient.Templates(ns).Create(&templatesapi.Template{ObjectMeta: kapi.ObjectMeta{Name: objName}}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("Error creating origin resource:%v", err)
+	}
+
+	testcases := []struct {
+		client   *restclient.RESTClient
+		resource string
+	}{
+		{
+			client:   clusterAdminKubeClient.RESTClient,
+			resource: "secrets",
+		},
+		{
+			client:   clusterAdminClient.RESTClient,
+			resource: "templates",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tc := range testcases {
+		successes := int32(0)
+
+
+
+		wg := sync.WaitGroup{}
+		for i := 0; i < (2 * apiserver.MaxPatchConflicts); i++ {
+			wg.Add(1)
+			go func(labelName string) {
+				defer wg.Done()
+				labelValue := uuid.NewRandom().String()
+
+				obj, err := tc.client.Patch(kapi.StrategicMergePatchType).
+					Namespace(ns).
+					Resource(tc.resource).
+					Name(objName).
+					Body([]byte(fmt.Sprintf(`{"metadata":{"labels":{"%s":"%s"}}}`, labelName, labelValue))).
+					Do().
+					Get()
+
+				if kapierrs.IsConflict(err) {
+					t.Logf("tolerated conflict error patching %s: %v", tc.resource, err)
+					return
+				}
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Errorf("error patching %s: %v", tc.resource, err)
+					return
+				}
+
+				accessor, err := meta.Accessor(obj)
+				if err != nil {
+					t.Errorf("error getting object from %s: %v", tc.resource, err)
+					return
+				}
+				if accessor.GetLabels()[labelName] != labelValue {
+					t.Errorf("patch of %s was ineffective, expected %s=%s, got labels %#v", tc.resource, labelName, labelValue, accessor.GetLabels())
+					return
+				}
+
+				atomic.AddInt32(&successes, 1)
+			}(fmt.Sprintf("label-%d", i))
+		}
+		wg.Wait()
+
+		if successes < apiserver.MaxPatchConflicts {
+			t.Errorf("Expected at least %d successful patches for %s, got %d", apiserver.MaxPatchConflicts, tc.resource, successes)
+		} else {
+			t.Logf("Got %d successful patches for %s", successes, tc.resource)
+		}
+	}
+}

+import gc
+import random
+
+import pytest
+
+from DnD_battler import AbilityDie, AttackRoll as RootAttackRoll, Dice, Proficiency
+from DnD_battler.dice import AttackRoll as DiceAttackRoll
+
+
+def set_rolls(monkeypatch, rolls):
+    queue = list(rolls)
+
+    def fake_randint(_low, _high):
+        if not queue:
+            raise AssertionError("test did not provide enough deterministic dice rolls")
+        value = queue.pop(0)
+        if not _low <= value <= _high:
+            raise AssertionError(f"deterministic dice roll {value} is invalid for d{_high}")
+        return value
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(random, "randint", fake_randint)
+
+
+def test_exports_and_constructor_preserve_bound_attack_state(monkeypatch):
+
+
+
+
+    ability_die = AbilityDie(bonus=2)
+    damage_dice = Dice(num_faces=[1])
+
+    roll = RootAttackRoll("training sword", ability_die, damage_dice, modifier=3)
+
+    assert RootAttackRoll is DiceAttackRoll
+    assert roll.name == "training sword"
+    assert roll.ability_die is ability_die
+    assert roll.damage_dice is damage_dice
+
+    modifier_probe = RootAttackRoll("modifier probe", AbilityDie(bonus=0), Dice(num_faces=[1]), modifier=3)
+    set_rolls(monkeypatch, [10, 1])
+    assert modifier_probe.attack(enemy_ac=13) == 1
+    set_rolls(monkeypatch, [10])
+    assert modifier_probe.attack(enemy_ac=14) == 0
+
+
+def test_attack_damage_depends_on_linked_ability_state_and_options(monkeypatch):
+
+
+
+
+    ability_die = AbilityDie(bonus=2)
+    damage_dice = Dice(num_faces=[1])
+    roll = RootAttackRoll("training sword", ability_die, damage_dice, modifier=3)
+
+    set_rolls(monkeypatch, [10])
+    assert roll.attack(enemy_ac=100) == 0
+
+    set_rolls(monkeypatch, [10, 1])
+    assert roll.attack(enemy_ac=-100) == 3
+
+    ability_die.temp_modifier = 1
+    set_rolls(monkeypatch, [10, 1])
+    assert roll.attack(enemy_ac=-100) == 4
+
+    set_rolls(monkeypatch, [10, 1])
+    assert roll.attack(enemy_ac=-100, add_ability_to_damage=False) == 1
+
+    ability_die.proficiency = Proficiency(level=5, modifier=0)

+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+
+from coremltools.converters.mil.mil import Builder as mb
+from coremltools.converters.mil.mil import Function, types
+
+
+def _reverse_sequence(x, lengths, seq_axis=None, batch_axis=None):
+    with Function({}):
+        kwargs = {"x": x, "lengths": lengths}
+        if seq_axis is not None:
+            kwargs["seq_axis"] = seq_axis
+        if batch_axis is not None:
+            kwargs["batch_axis"] = batch_axis
+        return mb.reverse_sequence(**kwargs)
+
+
+def test_reverse_sequence_evaluates_arbitrary_rank_with_negative_axes():
+    x = np.arange(24, dtype=np.float32).reshape(2, 3, 4)
+    result = _reverse_sequence(x, [3, 1, 4], seq_axis=-1, batch_axis=-2)
+
+    expected = np.array(
+        [
+            [[2, 1, 0, 3], [4, 5, 6, 7], [11, 10, 9, 8]],
+            [[14, 13, 12, 15], [16, 17, 18, 19], [23, 22, 21, 20]],
+        ],
+        dtype=np.float32,
+    )
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(result.val, expected)
+    assert result.dtype == types.fp32
+    assert tuple(result.shape) == x.shape
+
+
+def test_reverse_sequence_preserves_zero_and_full_length_boundaries():
+    x = np.arange(8, dtype=np.int32).reshape(2, 4)
+    result = _reverse_sequence(x, [0, 4], seq_axis=1, batch_axis=0)
+
+    expected = np.array([[0, 1, 2, 3], [7, 6, 5, 4]], dtype=np.int32)
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(result.val, expected)
+    assert result.dtype == types.int32
+
+
+def test_reverse_sequence_uses_tensorflow_compatible_default_axes():
+    x = np.array([[1, 10], [2, 20], [3, 30]], dtype=np.float32)
+    expected = np.array([[3, 10], [2, 20], [1, 30]], dtype=np.float32)
+
+    both_default = _reverse_sequence(x, [3, 1])
+    seq_default = _reverse_sequence(x, [3, 1], batch_axis=1)
+    batch_default = _reverse_sequence(x, [3, 1], seq_axis=0)
+    for result in (both_default, seq_default, batch_default):
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(result.val, expected)
+
+

import warnings, numpy as np
from .framework import Variable, in_dygraph_mode

def convert_dtype(dtype):
    if isinstance(dtype, str): return dtype
    return {0:'float32',1:'float64',2:'float16',3:'int32',4:'int64',5:'bool'}.get(int(dtype) if isinstance(dtype,int) else 0, 'float32')

def check_variable_and_dtype(input, input_name, expected_dtype, op_name, extra_message=''):
    check_type(input, input_name, Variable, op_name, extra_message)
    check_dtype(input.dtype, input_name, expected_dtype, op_name, extra_message)

def check_type(input, input_name, expected_type, op_name, extra_message=''):
    if in_dygraph_mode(): return
    if not isinstance(input, expected_type):
        raise TypeError("The type of '%s' in %s must be %s, but received %s. %s" %
            (input_name, op_name, expected_type, type(input), extra_message))

def check_dtype(input_dtype, input_name, expected_dtype, op_name, extra_message=''):
    if in_dygraph_mode(): return
    if convert_dtype(input_dtype) in ['float16']:
        warnings.warn("The data type of '%s' in %s only support float16 in GPU now. %s" %
            (input_name, op_name, extra_message))
    if convert_dtype(input_dtype) not in expected_dtype:
        raise TypeError("The data type of '%s' in %s must be %s, but received %s. %s" %
            (input_name, op_name, expected_dtype, convert_dtype(input_dtype), extra_message))

+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+import json
+from xml.etree import ElementTree
+
+from xsdata.formats.dataclass.parsers import JsonParser, XmlParser
+from xsdata.formats.dataclass.serializers import JsonSerializer, XmlSerializer
+from xsdata.formats.dataclass.context import XmlContext
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AnnotationBase:
+    title: str = field(metadata={"type": "Element", "namespace": ""})
+
+
+@dataclass
+class AnnotationDocument(AnnotationBase):
+    count: int = field(metadata={"type": "Element", "namespace": ""})
+
+    class Meta:
+        name = "document"
+        namespace = "urn:annotation"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PayloadNumber:
+    number: int = field(metadata={"type": "Element"})
+
+
+@dataclass
+class PayloadLabel:
+    label: str = field(metadata={"type": "Element"})
+
+
+@dataclass
+class ForwardEnvelope:
+    payload: "Payload" = field(metadata={"type": "Element"})
+
+
+@dataclass
+class SharedChild:
+    value: str = field(metadata={"type": "Element"})
+
+
+@dataclass
+class NamespaceA:
+    child: SharedChild = field(metadata={"type": "Element"})
+
+    class Meta:
+        namespace = "urn:a"
+
+
+@dataclass
+class NamespaceB:
+    child: SharedChild = field(metadata={"type": "Element"})
+
+    class Meta:
+        namespace = "urn:b"
+
+
+def test_lazy_annotations_include_inherited_fields_in_json_round_trip():
+    document = AnnotationDocument(title="report", count=3)
+    rendered = JsonSerializer().render(document)
+    assert json.loads(rendered) == {"title": "report", "count": 3}
+
+    parsed = JsonParser().from_string(rendered, AnnotationDocument)
+    assert parsed == document
+
+    parsed_from_text = JsonParser().from_string(
+        '{"title": "report", "count": "3"}',
+        AnnotationDocument,
+    )
+    assert parsed_from_text.count == 3
+    assert isinstance(parsed_from_text.count, int)
+
+
+def test_lazy_annotations_preserve_namespace_and_xml_round_trip():
+    document = AnnotationDocument(title="report", count=3)
+    rendered = XmlSerializer().render(document)
+    root = ElementTree.fromstring(rendered)
+    assert root.tag == "{urn:annotation}document"
+    assert [child.tag for child in root] == ["title", "count"]
+    assert [child.text for child in root] == ["report", "3"]
+
+    parsed = XmlParser().from_string(rendered, AnnotationDocument)
+    assert parsed == document
+
+
+def test_context_does_not_reuse_child_metadata_across_parent_namespaces():
+    context = XmlContext()
+    serializer = XmlSerializer(context=context)
+    first = ElementTree.fromstring(serializer.render(NamespaceA(SharedChild("a"))))
+    second = ElementTree.fromstring(serializer.render(NamespaceB(SharedChild("b"))))
+
+    assert first[0].tag == "{urn:a}child"
+    assert second[0].tag == "{urn:b}child"
+
+
+def test_forward_reference_uses_explicit_globalns():
+    context = XmlContext()
+    context.build(ForwardEnvelope, globalns={"Payload": PayloadLabel})
+    parser = JsonParser(context=context)
+    parsed = parser.from_string(
+        '{"payload": {"label": "ready"}}',
+        ForwardEnvelope,
+    )
+
+    assert parsed.payload.label == "ready"
+
+
+def test_context_globalns_override_is_not_stale_after_reuse():
+    context = XmlContext()
+    context.build(ForwardEnvelope, globalns={"Payload": PayloadNumber})
+
+    parser = JsonParser(context=context)
+    parsed_number = parser.decode({"payload": {"number": 7}}, ForwardEnvelope)
+    assert isinstance(parsed_number.payload, PayloadNumber)
+    assert parsed_number.payload.number == 7
+
+
+
+    context.build(ForwardEnvelope, globalns={"Payload": PayloadLabel})
+    parsed = parser.decode({"payload": {"label": "ready"}}, ForwardEnvelope)
+    assert isinstance(parsed.payload, PayloadLabel)
+    assert parsed.payload.label == "ready"

+from flask.ctx import _AppCtxGlobals

+from werkzeug.exceptions import UnprocessableEntity
+
+from indico.web.args import use_args, use_kwargs, use_rh_args, use_rh_kwargs
+
+
+class MockRequest:
+    def __init__(self, form=None, args=None, json=None, view_args=None, cookies=None, headers=None):
+        self.form = ImmutableMultiDict(form or {})
+        self.args = ImmutableMultiDict(args or {})
+        self.json = json
+        self.is_json = json is not None
+        self.view_args = view_args or {}
+        self.cookies = cookies or {}
+        self.headers = headers or {}
+        self.mimetype = 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' if json is None else 'application/json'
+
+    def get_data(self, cache=True):
+        return json.dumps(self.json)
+
+
+class ContextData(fields.String):
+    def __init__(self, key, **kwargs):
+        self.key = key
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+
+    def _deserialize(self, value, attr, data, **kwargs):
+        value = super()._deserialize(value, attr, data, **kwargs)
+        return value + self.context[self.key]
+
+
+def make_decorated_func(decorator, schema, req_or_form, **decorator_kwargs):
+    req = MockRequest(req_or_form) if not isinstance(req_or_form, MockRequest) else req_or_form
+
+    @decorator(schema, req=req, **decorator_kwargs)
+    def fn(args=None, **kwargs):
+        if decorator in (use_kwargs, use_rh_kwargs):
+            assert args is None
+            return kwargs
+        else:
+            assert not kwargs
+            return args
+
+    return fn
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('location', ('query', 'form', 'json', 'json_or_form'))
+def test_stripping_whitespace(location):
+    args = {
+        'a': ' 1337 ',
+        'b': '\ttest\n',
+        'c': ['  12 ', ' foo\t']
+    }
+    req = {
+        'query': MockRequest(args=args),
+        'form': MockRequest(form=args),
+        'json': MockRequest(json=args),
+        'json_or_form': MockRequest(form=args)
+    }[location]
+    fn = make_decorated_func(use_kwargs, {
+        'a': fields.Integer(),
+        'b': fields.String(),
+        'c': fields.List(fields.String()),
+    }, req, location=location)
+    assert fn() == {'a': 1337, 'b': 'test', 'c': ['12', 'foo']}
+
+

+        'form': MockRequest(form={'single': '123', 'multi': ['456', '789']}),
+        'json': MockRequest(json={'single': 123, 'multi': [456, 789]}),
+    }[location]
+    fn = make_decorated_func(use_kwargs, {
+        'single': fields.Integer(),
+        'multi': fields.List(fields.Integer()),
+    }, req, location=location)
+    assert fn() == {'single': 123, 'multi': [456, 789]}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('location', ('query', 'form', 'json'))

+    req = {

+        'form': MockRequest(form={'single': '123', 'multi': ['456', '789']}),
+        'json': MockRequest(json={'single': 123, 'multi': [456, 789]}),
+    }[location]
+    fn = make_decorated_func(use_kwargs, {
+        'single': fields.Integer(),
+        'multi': fields.List(fields.Integer()),
+    }, req)
+    if location == 'query':

+    else:

+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('decorator', (use_kwargs, use_args))

+    (False, {'a': '1', 'c': '3'}, {'a': 1, 'b': 'no-b', 'c': '3'}),

+    return store, registry
+

+def _parse(path: Path, parser: ZarrParser | None = None):
+    _, registry = _registry_for(path)
+    return (parser or ZarrParser())(url=path.as_uri(), registry=registry)
+
+
+def _manifest_dict(manifest_store, variable: str) -> dict:
+    vds = manifest_store.to_virtual_dataset(loadable_variables=[])
+    return vds[variable].data.manifest.dict()
+
+
+def _manifest_grid(manifest_store, variable: str) -> tuple[int, ...]:
+    vds = manifest_store.to_virtual_dataset(loadable_variables=[])
+    return vds[variable].data.manifest.shape_chunk_grid
+

+def _query_dataset() -> xr.Dataset:
+    return xr.Dataset(
+        {"data": (("x", "y"), np.arange(36, dtype="float32").reshape(6, 6))}
+    )
+
+
+def _write_dense_store(path: Path, zarr_format: int) -> xr.Dataset:
+    ds = _query_dataset()
+    ds.to_zarr(
+        path,
+        encoding={"data": {"chunks": (2, 2)}},
+        consolidated=False,
+        zarr_format=zarr_format,
+    )
+    return ds
+
+

+    base = path.as_uri()
+    return {

+            "length": 25,
+        }
+        for i in range(3)
+        for j in range(3)
+    }
+

+    base = path.as_uri()
+    return {
+        f"{i}.{j}": {
+            "path": f"{base}/data/{i}.{j}",
+            "offset": 0,
+            "length": 32,
+        }
+        for i in range(3)
+        for j in range(3)
+    }
+
+
+def _write_sparse_store(path: Path) -> None:
+    group = zarr.group(store=path, overwrite=True, zarr_format=3)
+    array = group.create_array(
+        "data",
+        shape=(30, 30),

+        dtype="float32",

+                {"deep": (("z",), np.arange(8, dtype="float32") + 40)}

+import unittest
+
+from quarkchain.core import Branch, Address, Identity
+
+
+def make_full_shard_id(chain_id, shard_size, shard_id):
+    return (chain_id << 16) | shard_size | shard_id
+
+
+class TestBranchChainId(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_zero_chain_id_backward_compatible(self):
+        b = Branch(make_full_shard_id(0, 8, 6))
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_chain_id(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_size(), 8)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_id(), 6)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_full_shard_id(), 8 | 6)
+
+    def test_nonzero_chain_id(self):
+        value = make_full_shard_id(3, 8, 6)
+        b = Branch(value)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_chain_id(), 3)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_size(), 8)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_id(), 6)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_full_shard_id(), value)
+
+    def test_chain_id_does_not_affect_shard_fields(self):
+
+        for chain_id in (0, 1, 2, 7, 100, 65535):
+            b = Branch(make_full_shard_id(chain_id, 4, 2))
+            self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_size(), 4)
+            self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_id(), 2)
+            self.assertEqual(b.get_chain_id(), chain_id)
+
+    def test_single_shard(self):
+        b = Branch(make_full_shard_id(5, 1, 0))
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_size(), 1)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_shard_id(), 0)
+        self.assertEqual(b.get_chain_id(), 5)
+
+
+class TestBranchIsInBranch(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+
+        self.branch = Branch(make_full_shard_id(3, 4, 2))
+
+    def test_matching_key(self):
+
+        key = (3 << 16) | 6
+        self.assertTrue(self.branch.is_in_branch(key))
+
+    def test_matching_key_other_high_bits(self):
+
+        key = (3 << 16) | 14
+        self.assertTrue(self.branch.is_in_branch(key))
+
+    def test_wrong_chain(self):
+        key = (2 << 16) | 6
+        self.assertFalse(self.branch.is_in_branch(key))
+
+    def test_wrong_shard(self):
+        key = (3 << 16) | 5
+        self.assertFalse(self.branch.is_in_branch(key))
+
+
+class TestAddressFullShardId(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_computes_full_shard_id(self):
+
+        addr = Address(bytes(20), (5 << 16) | 0b1011)
+
+        self.assertEqual(addr.get_full_shard_id(4), make_full_shard_id(5, 4, 3))
+
+        self.assertEqual(addr.get_full_shard_id(8), make_full_shard_id(5, 8, 3))
+
+        self.assertEqual(addr.get_full_shard_id(1), make_full_shard_id(5, 1, 0))
+
+    def test_zero_chain(self):
+        addr = Address(bytes(20), 0b1101)
+        self.assertEqual(addr.get_full_shard_id(4), make_full_shard_id(0, 4, 1))
+
+    def test_invalid_shard_size_raises(self):
+        addr = Address(bytes(20), (1 << 16) | 5)
+        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
+            addr.get_full_shard_id(3)
+        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
+            addr.get_full_shard_id(6)
+
+
+class TestAddressInBranch(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_rehome_keeps_recipient_and_adopts_chain_and_shard(self):
+        recipient = Identity.create_random_identity().get_recipient()
+
+        addr = Address(recipient, (1 << 16) | 0b1101)
+
+        branch = Branch(make_full_shard_id(4, 4, 2))
+        new_addr = addr.address_in_branch(branch)
+
+        self.assertEqual(new_addr.recipient, recipient)
+
+        self.assertEqual(new_addr.full_shard_key, (4 << 16) | 14)
+
+        self.assertTrue(branch.is_in_branch(new_addr.full_shard_key))
+
+    def test_rehome_single_shard(self):
+        recipient = Identity.create_random_identity().get_recipient()
+        addr = Address(recipient, (2 << 16) | 0b111)
+        branch = Branch(make_full_shard_id(0, 1, 0))
+        new_addr = addr.address_in_branch(branch)
+        self.assertEqual(new_addr.recipient, recipient)
+        self.assertEqual(new_addr.full_shard_key, 0b111)
+        self.assertTrue(branch.is_in_branch(new_addr.full_shard_key))
+
+
+class TestConsistency(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_address_branch_round_trip(self):
+        addr = Address(bytes(20), (6 << 16) | 0b10110)
+        for shard_size in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16):
+            full_shard_id = addr.get_full_shard_id(shard_size)
+            branch = Branch(full_shard_id)
+            self.assertEqual(branch.get_chain_id(), 6)
+            self.assertEqual(branch.get_shard_size(), shard_size)
+            self.assertTrue(branch.is_in_branch(addr.full_shard_key))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

pkill -f "okexchaind start" 2>/dev/null || true

# remove existing daemon and client
rm -rf "$HOME_BASE"

okexchaincli config keyring-backend test --home "$HOME_CLI"
okexchaincli config chain-id "$CHAINID" --home "$HOME_CLI"
okexchaincli config output json --home "$HOME_CLI"
okexchaincli config indent true --home "$HOME_CLI"
okexchaincli config trust-node true --home "$HOME_CLI"

cat "$HOME_SERVER/config/genesis.json" | jq '.app_state["mint"]["params"]["mint_denom"]="okt"' > "$HOME_SERVER/config/tmp_genesis.json" && mv "$HOME_SERVER/config/tmp_genesis.json" "$HOME_SERVER/config/genesis.json"

sed -i 's/"enable_call": false/"enable_call": true/' "$HOME_SERVER/config/genesis.json"

okexchaind add-genesis-account $(okexchaincli keys show "$KEY1" -a --home "$HOME_CLI") 1000000000okt --home "$HOME_SERVER"
okexchaind add-genesis-account $(okexchaincli keys show "$KEY2" -a --home "$HOME_CLI") 1000000000okt --home "$HOME_SERVER"

okexchaind validate-genesis --home "$HOME_SERVER"

LOG_LEVEL=main:info,state:info,distr:debug,auth:info,mint:debug,farm:debug

# Start the node in the background with EVM support
okexchaind start \
  --pruning=nothing \
  --rpc.unsafe \
  --rest.laddr tcp://0.0.0.0:8545 \
  --chain-id "$CHAINID" \
  --log_level "$LOG_LEVEL" \
  --trace \
  --home "$HOME_SERVER" \
  --rest.unlock_key "$KEY1","$KEY2" \
  --rest.unlock_key_home "$HOME_CLI" \
  --keyring-backend "test" \
  --minimum-gas-prices "0.000000001okt" &

NODE_PID=$!

# Wait for the node to be ready
echo "Waiting for okexchaind to start..."
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -s -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_blockNumber","params":[],"id":1}' http://localhost:8545 > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "Node is ready after ${i}s"
    break
  fi
  if [ $i -eq 60 ]; then
    echo "Node failed to start in 60 seconds"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 1
done

# Run the target tests
go test -v -count=1 -timeout 300s -run "TestWebsocket_Logs" ./app/rpc/tests/ 2>&1
TEST_EXIT=$?

# Exit with test exit code
exit $TEST_EXIT

+import gc
+import textwrap
+from typing import Union
+
+import pytest
+
+import libcst as cst
+import libcst.matchers as m
+from libcst.codemod import (
+    CodemodContext,
+    TransformSuccess,
+    VisitorBasedCodemodCommand,
+    transform_module,
+)
+from libcst.codemod.visitors import RemoveImportsVisitor
+from libcst.metadata import QualifiedNameProvider, ScopeProvider
+
+
+def _clean_code(source: str) -> str:
+    code = textwrap.dedent(source)
+    lines = code.split("\n")
+    while lines and lines[0] == "":
+        lines = lines[1:]
+    while lines and lines[-1] == "":
+        lines = lines[:-1]
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def _run_remove_with_context(source: str, context: CodemodContext) -> str:
+    return RemoveImportsVisitor(context).transform_module(cst.parse_module(source)).code
+
+
+def test_context_scheduled_removals_evolve_and_remove_only_unused_imports() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    context = CodemodContext()
+
+    assert (
+        _run_remove_with_context("import os\nprint(os.getcwd())\n", context)
+        == "import os\nprint(os.getcwd())\n"
+    )
+
+    RemoveImportsVisitor.remove_unused_import(context, "typing", "Optional")
+
+    assert (
+        _run_remove_with_context(
+            "from typing import Optional, List\nx: List[int]\n", context
+        )
+        == "from typing import List\nx: List[int]\n"
+    )
+
+    RemoveImportsVisitor.remove_unused_import(context, "os")
+
+    assert (
+        _run_remove_with_context(
+            "from typing import Optional\nimport os\nvalue = 1\n", context
+        )
+        == "value = 1\n"
+    )
+    assert (
+        _run_remove_with_context("import os, sys\nprint(sys.version)\n", context)
+        == "import sys\nprint(sys.version)\n"
+    )
+    assert (
+        _run_remove_with_context("import os\nprint(os.getcwd())\n", context)
+        == "import os\nprint(os.getcwd())\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_direct_constructor_input_applies_without_mutating_context() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    context = CodemodContext()
+    visitor = RemoveImportsVisitor(context, [("typing", "Optional", None)])
+
+
+    assert (
+        visitor.transform_module(
+            cst.parse_module("from typing import Optional, List\nx: List[int]\n")
+        ).code
+        == "from typing import List\nx: List[int]\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_constructor_combines_prior_context_state_with_direct_input() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    context = CodemodContext()
+    RemoveImportsVisitor.remove_unused_import(context, "os")
+
+    visitor = RemoveImportsVisitor(context, [("typing", "Optional", None)])
+
+
+    assert (
+        visitor.transform_module(
+            cst.parse_module("import os\nfrom typing import Optional\nvalue = 3\n")
+        ).code
+        == "value = 3\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_alias_specific_removal_keeps_differently_aliased_imports() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    matching = CodemodContext()
+    RemoveImportsVisitor.remove_unused_import(matching, "pkg.mod", "Thing", "Alias")
+    assert (
+        _run_remove_with_context(
+            "from pkg.mod import Thing as Alias, Other\nprint(Other)\n", matching
+        )
+        == "from pkg.mod import Other\nprint(Other)\n"
+    )
+
+    different = CodemodContext()
+    RemoveImportsVisitor.remove_unused_import(different, "pkg.mod", "Thing", "Alias")
+    assert (
+        _run_remove_with_context(
+            "from pkg.mod import Thing as Different, Other\nprint(Other)\n",
+            different,
+        )
+        == "from pkg.mod import Thing as Different, Other\nprint(Other)\n"
+    )
+
+
+def test_parenthesized_import_comment_is_preserved_on_remaining_alias() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+    context = CodemodContext()
+    RemoveImportsVisitor.remove_unused_import(context, "pkg.mod", "Thing")
+
+    result = _run_remove_with_context(
+        _clean_code(
+            """
+            from pkg.mod import (
+                Thing,
+                # keep near Other
+                Other,
+            )
+            print(Other)
+            """
+        ),
+        context,
+    )
+
+    assert "Thing" not in result
+    assert "Other" in result
+    assert "# keep near Other" in result
+    assert cst.parse_module(result).code == result
+
+
+def test_node_based_helper_schedules_deleted_annotation_import() -> None:
+
+
+
+
+
+    class RemoveAnnotatedAssignment(VisitorBasedCodemodCommand):
+        METADATA_DEPENDENCIES = (QualifiedNameProvider, ScopeProvider)
+
+        def leave_AnnAssign(
+            self, original_node: cst.AnnAssign, updated_node: cst.AnnAssign
+        ) -> Union[cst.RemovalSentinel, cst.AnnAssign]:
+            if m.matches(original_node, m.AnnAssign(target=m.Name("x"))):
+                self.remove_unused_import_by_node(original_node)
+                return cst.RemoveFromParent()
+            return updated_node
+

+        "from typing import Optional\nx: Optional[int] = None\ny = 1\n",
+    )

+

+
+
+
+
+    context = CodemodContext()
+    statement = cst.ensure_type(
+        cst.parse_statement("from .foo import Bar\n"), cst.SimpleStatementLine
+    )

+
+
+
+
+
+
+
+import sys
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/repo")
+
+from InvPT.evaluation.eval_sal import SaliencyMeter as InvPTSaliencyMeter
+from TaskPrompter.evaluation.eval_sal import SaliencyMeter as TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter
+
+
+PERFECT_PREDS = torch.tensor([[[0.0, 255.0], [0.0, 255.0]]])
+PERFECT_TARGET = torch.tensor([[[0, 1], [0, 1]]])
+SINGLETON_IGNORE_PREDS = torch.tensor([[[255.0, 0.0], [255.0, 0.0]]])
+SINGLETON_IGNORE_TARGET = torch.tensor([[[[1, 255], [0, 1]]]])
+ALL_POSITIVE_PREDS = torch.tensor([[[255.0, 255.0], [255.0, 255.0]]])
+ALL_NEGATIVE_TARGET = torch.tensor([[[0, 0], [0, 0]]])
+
+
+def _scaled_score(meter_cls, value):
+    if meter_cls is TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter:
+        return value * 100
+    return value
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("meter_cls", "expected_score"),
+    [
+        (TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter, {"maxF": 100.0}),
+        (InvPTSaliencyMeter, {"maxF": 1.0}),
+    ],
+)
+def test_threshold_point_six_perfect_session_accumulates_counts(meter_cls, expected_score):
+
+
+    meter = meter_cls(threshold_step=0.6, beta_squared=1)
+
+
+    assert set(meter.get_score(verbose=False)) == {"maxF"}
+
+    meter.update(PERFECT_PREDS, PERFECT_TARGET)
+    assert meter.get_score(verbose=False) == expected_score
+
+    meter.update(ALL_POSITIVE_PREDS, ALL_NEGATIVE_TARGET)
+
+    assert meter.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(_scaled_score(meter_cls, 0.5))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("meter_cls", "expected_maxf"),
+    [
+        (TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter, 66.66666865348816),
+        (InvPTSaliencyMeter, 0.6666666865348816),
+    ],
+)
+def test_threshold_point_five_counts_zero_predictions_as_positive(meter_cls, expected_maxf):
+
+
+    meter = meter_cls(threshold_step=0.5, beta_squared=1)
+
+    meter.update(PERFECT_PREDS, PERFECT_TARGET)
+
+    assert meter.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(expected_maxf)
+
+    meter.update(PERFECT_PREDS, PERFECT_TARGET)
+
+    assert meter.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(expected_maxf)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("meter_cls", "expected_score"),
+    [
+        (TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter, {"maxF": 50.0}),
+        (InvPTSaliencyMeter, {"maxF": 0.5}),
+    ],
+)
+def test_singleton_channel_target_is_squeezed_and_ignore_index_is_masked(meter_cls, expected_score):
+
+
+    meter = meter_cls(ignore_index=255, threshold_step=0.6, beta_squared=1)
+
+    meter.update(SINGLETON_IGNORE_PREDS, SINGLETON_IGNORE_TARGET)
+
+    assert meter.get_score(verbose=False) == expected_score
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("meter_cls", [TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter, InvPTSaliencyMeter])
+def test_incompatible_update_shapes_raise_assertion_error(meter_cls):
+
+
+    meter = meter_cls(threshold_step=0.6, beta_squared=1)
+    bad_target = torch.tensor([[[0, 1], [0, 1], [0, 1]]])
+
+    with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
+        meter.update(PERFECT_PREDS, bad_target)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("meter_cls", [TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter, InvPTSaliencyMeter])
+def test_separate_instances_keep_independent_accumulated_counts(meter_cls):
+
+
+    a = meter_cls(threshold_step=0.6, beta_squared=1)
+    b = meter_cls(threshold_step=0.6, beta_squared=1)
+
+    a.update(PERFECT_PREDS, PERFECT_TARGET)
+
+    assert a.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(_scaled_score(meter_cls, 1.0))
+
+    b.update(ALL_POSITIVE_PREDS, ALL_NEGATIVE_TARGET)
+    assert b.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(0.0)
+    assert a.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(_scaled_score(meter_cls, 1.0))
+
+    b.update(PERFECT_PREDS, PERFECT_TARGET)
+    assert b.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(_scaled_score(meter_cls, 0.5))
+    assert a.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"] == pytest.approx(_scaled_score(meter_cls, 1.0))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("meter_cls", [TaskPrompterSaliencyMeter, InvPTSaliencyMeter])
+def test_repeated_create_update_drop_cycles_do_not_retain_session_objects(meter_cls):
+
+
+    scores = []
+
+    for _ in range(120):
+        meter = meter_cls(threshold_step=0.6, beta_squared=1)
+        meter.update(PERFECT_PREDS, PERFECT_TARGET)
+        score = meter.get_score(verbose=False)["maxF"]
+
+        assert score == pytest.approx(_scaled_score(meter_cls, 1.0))
+        scores.append(score)
+        del meter
+
+    assert len(scores) == 120

+func TestFsckPrintsStartupAndProgress(t *testing.T) {
+	u := gptest.NewUnitTester(t)
+	defer u.Remove()

+func TestFsckSuppressesProgressWhenOutputHidden(t *testing.T) {
+	u := gptest.NewUnitTester(t)
+	defer u.Remove()

+

+
+func addFsckEntries(t *testing.T, u *gptest.Unit, names ...string) {
+	for _, name := range names {
+		fn := filepath.Join(u.StoreDir(""), name+".txt")
+		assert.NoError(t, ioutil.WriteFile(fn, []byte("secret"), 0600))
+	}
+}
+
+func firstOutputLineBefore(output, later string) bool {
+	for _, line := range strings.Split(output, "\n") {
+		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
+		if line == "" {
+			continue
+		}
+		return !strings.Contains(line, later)
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func hasVisibleProgressUpdate(output string, minTotal int) bool {
+	fields := strings.FieldsFunc(output, func(r rune) bool {
+		return r < '0' || r > '9'
+	})
+	for i := 0; i+1 < len(fields); i++ {
+		current, err := strconv.Atoi(fields[i])
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		total, err := strconv.Atoi(fields[i+1])
+		if err != nil {
+			continue
+		}
+		if current > 0 && total >= minTotal && current <= total {
+			return true
+		}
+	}
+	return false
+}
+
+func captureProcessStdout(t *testing.T, fn func() error) (string, error) {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	oldOut := out.Stdout
+	oldStdout := stdout
+	defer func() {
+		out.Stdout = oldOut
+		stdout = oldStdout
+	}()
+
+	origFD, err := syscall.Dup(int(os.Stdout.Fd()))
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	defer syscall.Close(origFD)
+
+	r, w, err := os.Pipe()
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+
+	var buf bytes.Buffer
+	done := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, copyErr := io.Copy(&buf, r)
+		done <- copyErr
+	}()
+
+	if err := syscall.Dup2(int(w.Fd()), int(os.Stdout.Fd())); err != nil {
+		_ = r.Close()
+		_ = w.Close()
+		return "", err
+	}
+	out.Stdout = os.Stdout
+	stdout = os.Stdout
+
+	runErr := fn()
+
+	_ = syscall.Dup2(origFD, int(os.Stdout.Fd()))
+	_ = w.Close()
+	copyErr := <-done
+	_ = r.Close()
+	if copyErr != nil {
+		return buf.String(), copyErr
+	}
+	return buf.String(), runErr
+}
